verdict.rationale: Anytype's first-party agents skill says an agent can run scripts against your Anytype data to handle bulk edits, transformations, and repetitive tasks. That rests on the localhost API, headless CLI and MCP server. However, bulk work depends on scripting through an external agent tool (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) looping over the API, not on a native multi-item operation. A user also reports needing a merge feature when re-importing CSV data into large databases, which points to a bulk-update gap. Missing for 10: a documented native batch/bulk endpoint or in-app multi-select bulk edit, concrete docs or examples of bulk operations, and independent hands-on corroboration.
